message: FID is no longer a Core Web Vital: INP replaced it in March 2024 (https://web.dev/blog/inp-cwv-launch).
Create React App was deprecated for new apps in February 2025 (https://react.dev/blog/2025/02/14/sunsetting-create-react-app).
Recoil was archived in January 2025 (https://github.com/facebookexperimental/Recoil). Mention it only as archived.
